translations.en: For now, I'll brief you on the findings.
Come with me.
Where to?
As Levia turned, Shuri, though loaded with bags,
reached out to take the bags I was holding as well
I dodged Shuri and asked casually.
The vague answer I got was unexpected.
I commandeered the lord's mansion for the search HQ.
Commandeering and looting are things Levia hates most.
Moreover, Milfe--visited for the princess search--
is not Lewinian territory; it could be seen as
an invasion.
What happened?
From beside the silent Levia, a man stepped out.
Lord Celica, that was by knights who admire Levia
It was carried out by some common-born knights.
Lord Ranzabu--vice-commander of Levia's knights,
he is a man with many dark rumors.
They wanted General Levia to work in comfort,
but they went overboard, it seems.
Ranzabu shook his head, feigning distress.
We paid the lord of this town a proper sum
and arranged to rent the mansion.
Because those common knights lacked consideration,
we are treated as invaders in this town.
Indeed, in the eyes of the watching townspeople,
there is little goodwill.
Enough, Lord Ranzabu. It's all settled...
Yes, that is true.
I overstepped and spoke presumptuously.
Please forgive me.
In Ranzabu's words,
there was a note of blame toward Levia.
A snake in the grass...
This Ranzabu--he was promoted by nobles who resent
the fact that Levia is a female general.
I hear.
